content.value: Select a supported recipe that you have discovered to program the [[item/minecraft:crafter|Crafter]]. It uses a material-based recipe selection instead of requiring a shaped crafting-grid layout.
Once programmed, the recipe continues working independently of the player who selected it, including while that player is offline.

Each valid redstone pulse requests one crafting operation. The [[item/minecraft:crafter|Crafter]] checks its own available materials and ejects the result through its normal world operation. It does not take materials from an absent player inventory.
Programming a recipe does not share that recipe discovery with every other player. Your own station lists still use your individual discoveries.
